anchor.flag: the study's T-0.6B has a gate-pooled CER worse than the anchor's by > 5 % relative with a paired CI excluding 0
anchor.then: interpretation halts until the cause (BN, L2-SP, LR, data) is understood

baselines.source: the sidecar's baselines: corpus CER (kitsune.evaluate.corpus_cer) on the manifest rows; m4 = the macro mean over eval_jsut, eval_cv8, eval_reazon, galgame_neutral

branch.what: <run>-half resumes the local full state at 0.4 x max_steps and cools down to 0.5 x max_steps: the WSD schedule of a run whose budget is T/2 (same warm-up, stable LR and data order, 20 % cooldown); one complete eval at its end

budget.follow_up_rule: conditional on the trigger, and only if the contingency is unused
follow_ups: a d-pruned P-0.1B if P-0.1B is OUTSIDE
a 2T extension from the pre-cooldown state if T/2 -> T says compute-limited
a second replicate if a decisive call falls within about 1 sigma of delta

calibration.excluded: evals, checkpoints and the T/2 branch do not count toward T
calibration.loader_bound: data_wait_frac >= 0.05: perf.num_workers 12 and calibrate again; still >= 0.05: the box halts
calibration.max_steps: max_steps_i = round(9366 x t_study-t06 / t_i), half up
calibration.t_i: the median step time over steps 50-250 at the planned micro_audio_s, logging included, on the study host with the run's wave group running concurrently

cohere_prereg.note: K11: recomputed from labels/full/teacher_out; a drift means re-registering the baselines or reusing the laptop's eval labels before this commit

data.reazon_large_cap: the smallest reazon_large input count whose pool after all filters holds >= 1010 h (expected 50-55), read from the sealed labels (the sidecar's details.pool_hours_if_capped; the fill refuses any other count)

1.answer: the limit: tolerance delta 10 % against the family's largest student; delta 5 and 20 % also reported

10.answer: M4 within a family; JSUT+Galgame across families, descriptive only

11.answer: Galgame neutral view (cer(kotoba, ref) <= 0.5) as primary; the other two reported

12.answer: P-0.1B and P-0.05B as the d = 1024 ladder, B8x768 and B4x768

13.answer: shared agreement filter CER(Transcribe hyp, Parakeet TDT hyp) <= 0.5

14.answer: eval-leak dedup: exact normalised text match against eval references of >= 15 characters

15.answer: frame mismatches: drop and count; hard fail above 0.1 % of train rows or on any eval row

16.answer: BN of pruned students: teacher stats, frozen; recal for both pruned Transcribe students if T-0.6B's CPU step-0 KL is not lower with the teacher stats

19.answer: re-initialise the subsampling conv; keep the 16,384 tied vocabulary

2.answer: one 4x A100 SXM4 40 GB box, calibration + probes + 2 waves; S3b, then S1p as fallbacks

20.answer: aux CTC 0.3 for the scratch AED runs, the bridge included

21.answer: dropout 0 and the first run's SpecAugment for all runs

22.answer: Parakeet CTC target: the greedy CTC path

24.answer: the CTC trainer is a family switch inside 04_distill

26.answer: equal compute on the steps clock with calibrated max_steps

27.answer: students built on the laptop CPU

28.answer: the speed probe on the A100

29.answer: re-score the first run's 0.6B (step_9774) on the manifest

3.answer: control runs: the bridge and a replicate of T-0.1B with seed 1235

30.answer: follow-ups conditional on their triggers only

4.answer: budget cuts in this order: the replicate, T at 3 epochs, the contingency; never stage away 0.05B

5.answer: HF storage: no action (HF PRO, 1 TB)

6.answer: a T/2 branch in every run

7.answer: LR probes for all classes plus the bridge

8.answer: PREREG numbers written by the box; it halts only on a check fixed in advance

evals.checkpoint: the final one, never the best eval; plus the branch's
evals.reported: per set, group and pooled: corpus CER, ratio to the own teacher, imitation CER, no-style CER, S/D/I, runaway rate (CER > 100 % or hyp > 2 x ref), empty-output rate, AED truncation; teacher-forced KL/CE (AED) or dense/blank KL, CTC per token, argmax agreement and argmax-blank share (CTC); probe vs held-out KL; step-seconds, steps, epochs, audio-hours; params total and non-embedding; speed and VRAM

halts: an LR probe winner at a grid edge after its one extension
the frame preflight above 0.1 % of train rows or on any eval row
a selection, manifest or PREREG hash that differs from this file
invalid_if: a run misses its max_steps, or resumes with a changed config
a selection or manifest hash differs between runs
the teacher baselines do not reproduce
K3 or K4 fails, or the frame preflight exceeds its threshold
this rules commit comes after any study result, or PREREG_numbers.json after the first study step
the anchor regression flag fires and stays unexplained
an LR winner sits at a grid edge after its one extension
calibration stays loader-bound after raising the workers

calls.OUTSIDE: the CI's lower end > ln(1 + delta)
calls.WITHIN: the CI's upper end <= ln(1 + delta)

limit_rule.replicate_role: study-t01-s1235 feeds sigma_run only; the walk uses study-t01
limit_rule.walk: down the sizes: the limit is the smallest size WITHIN with every larger size WITHIN; the first OUTSIDE ends it (limit between X and Y); an UNRESOLVED gives 'at or below X, Y unresolved' and the smaller sizes are descriptive; one decisive claim per family, no Holm correction

lr_probes.edge_rule: a winner at an edge of the tested grid gets one more point (x2 above, /2 below); a winner at an edge after that extension halts the box (an invalidation rule)
lr_probes.objective: the family's training objective per target token, teacher-forced, at the probe's end, pooled over the complete gate sets eval_jsut, eval_cv8, eval_reazon (AED: w_kl KL + w_ce CE without aux CTC; CTC: w_kl KL + w_ctc CTC); lowest wins; a non-finite objective loses; a tie goes to the lower LR

manifest.source: python -m kitsune.prereg --write study/ --sidecar labels/full/selections/study_1000h.json, from the selection built on the sealed labels (scripts/make_selection.py --config study/data.json)

metrics.cer: kitsune.evaluate.corpus_cer: sum(S+D+I) / sum(ref chars) on normalize_ja text, empty refs skipped
metrics.cross_family: JSUT + Galgame-neutral, raw and no-style, paired CIs; descriptive only, no threshold

galgame_views.all: every Galgame hold-out row of the manifest
galgame_views.label_box: the label box's filter: not truncated and agree(Cohere, Parakeet) <= 0.5
galgame_views.neutral: primary: the rows whose kotoba-whisper-v2.0 hypothesis (the laptop's second_out/galgame/eval-00000.jsonl) has cer(hyp2, ref) <= 0.5 and a non-empty reference

metrics.m4: the macro mean of complete-set corpus CER over eval_jsut, eval_cv8, eval_reazon and Galgame-neutral, equal weights (within-family primary)
metrics.strata: every eval set is one stratum, Galgame is its three views instead: eval_jsut, eval_cv8, eval_reazon, eval_emilia, galgame_neutral, galgame_all, galgame_label_box

bootstrap.kind: paired utterance bootstrap, stratified: resampled within each stratum, the same indices for every system

numbers.when: written and uploaded by the study box, its sha256 logged as an event, before the first study step

practical_bars: the smallest student whose JSUT+Galgame-neutral CI upper end is <= Parakeet 0.6B TDT
the smallest student within 1.2x and within 1.5x of its own teacher on M4
a Pareto view: CER against A100 RTF and VRAM

readouts.budget: per non-top size the call at T/2 and at T; Delta = ln r(T) - ln r(T/2) with CI (v_boot + 2 sigma_run^2): below 0 -> 'compute-limited: the gap closes with compute', else 'not compute-limited at T'
readouts.distillation_gaps: M4(T-0.6B)/M4(Cohere) and M4(P-0.3B)/M4(Parakeet CTC); not steps of the walk
readouts.g_per_halving: every step with a CI; descriptive only
readouts.parakeet_labels: P 0.3 -> 0.1 is always labelled 'size + loss of function + depth'; P 0.1 -> 0.05 is clean
readouts.scratch_ladder: bridge -> T-0.1B -> T-0.05B, a second tolerance walk with top = bridge; the acceleration g(0.1->0.05) - g(0.3s->0.1) with a CI, reported only here

study-p005.shape: Parakeet encoder 4 layers [0,8,15,23], FFN 768; CTC head

study-p01.shape: Parakeet encoder 8 layers [0,3,7,10,13,16,20,23], FFN 768; CTC head

study-p03.shape: Parakeet encoder 16 of 24 layers [0,2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12,14,15,17,18,20,21,23], d 1024, FFN 4096 -> 2560; the Parakeet CTC head verbatim (3,073 classes)

study-t005.shape: encoder 10 layers, d 384, 6 x 64, FFN 1536, kernel 9; decoder 3 layers, D 384, 6 x 64, FFN 1536; vocab 16,384 tied

study-t01.shape: encoder 12 layers, d 512, 8 x 64, FFN 2048, kernel 9; decoder 4 layers, D 512, 8 x 64, FFN 2048; vocab 16,384 tied

selection.coverage: launch refuses a selection with any eval row not_in_parakeet (K6: both passes label the eval sets whole) or more than 0.1 % of its train rows not_in_parakeet (K5)
selection.frame_preflight: at store build, for every row: the ParakeetFeatureExtractor length of the rebuilt audio, 8x subsampled, equals the stored n_frames; mismatches are dropped and counted, the box fails above 0.1 % of train rows or on any eval row (decision 15)
rules: 1 not_in_parakeet: candidates are the extent's rows present in both teacher_out and parakeet_out
2 F0, the label box's judges: truncated (Cohere, no EOS); no_agree; agree>A with A = 0.5 for Reazon (whisper-large-v3) and Galgame (Parakeet), 0.2 for Emilia-YODAS and NC (Emilia's WhisperX text)
3 f1a_disagree: CER(Transcribe hyp, Parakeet TDT hyp) > 0.5, normalised by Parakeet's length
4 eval_dup: the normalised reference or Cohere hypothesis equals an eval or hold-out reference of >= 15 characters
5 ctc_infeasible: U + adjacent repeats of the greedy CTC target > n_frames
6 not_drawn: keep = a seeded 3,600,000 s subset pooled over the sources (the frozen train list; subset.train_audio_s null for all runs); probe = 300 kept rows per train source (1,500)
7 eval sets: every row present in both roots, unfiltered (filter_eval_sets []); views at scoring

study: Kitsune size study: 7 students + bridge + replicate on the same 1,000 h at equal A100 compute

aux_ctc.head: training-only nn.Linear(d_enc, 16,385), dropped at export
aux_ctc.weight: 0.3 for the scratch runs (bridge included), 0 otherwise

aed_loss.kl: 17 bins: the stored top-16 plus a rest bucket, T = 1

all_runs.memory: the memory probe confirms each micro_audio_s; aux-CTC runs fall back to micro 1200 if 1600 does not fit, and calibration measures the consequence
all_runs.schedule: WSD on the steps clock: linear warm-up, stable, 1 - sqrt cooldown over the last 20 % of max_steps
all_runs.specaugment: the first run's: 2 frequency masks of 27, 2-5 time masks of 5 %

training.bn_fallback: BN of pruned students: teacher stats, frozen; recal for both pruned Transcribe students if T-0.6B's CPU step-0 KL is not lower with the teacher stats

ctc_loss.alignment: ParakeetFeatureExtractor features (80 mel, preemphasis 0.97, per-feature normalisation, no dither); no speed/tempo change, time warp, crop or concat
ctc_loss.dense_frames: p_blank < 0.95: the stored top-8 union {blank} plus a rest bucket
ctc_loss.normaliser: N_u, the CTC target tokens of the step
ctc_loss.target: Parakeet's greedy CTC path, ctc_greedy(ctc_col0(...)) = the jsonl ctc_hyp

pruned_lost.definition: a pruned student whose step-0 CER against its teacher is >= 90 % on the 60-utterance CPU gate

scratch.bn: train mode; evals use the running stats; grad_ckpt off

replicate.when: on its own 1x box once PREREG_numbers.json exists
